## How it was checked

- [ ] `scripts/run.sh check` passes (type check, tests, build)
- [ ] New or changed logic has unit tests (a bug fix has a test that fails without it)
- [ ] Checked in the browser; screenshot or clip attached for UI changes
- [ ] New strings added to `vi.ts`, `en.ts` and `fr.ts`
- [ ] New or changed regex timed on hostile input (result: …)
- [ ] CHANGELOG (`Unreleased`) and ADR updated if user-visible behaviour changed
